capabilities: Draw freehand marker, highlighter, and washi-tape annotations stored as inline SVG
Create blank, new, or existing-note cards in a single drag
Drag a marquee to create and rename canvas sections
Build and edit borderless interactive tables with reorder and resize handles
Insert vault images via a thumbnail picker or upload
extras: Relies on undocumented Canvas internals (posFromEvt, createTextNode, etc.) and may need a patch after Obsidian updates; ink renders as raw SVG on devices without the plugin, though content is never lost. Pending community plugin review; manual install instructions provided.
intentEvidence: A complete re-vamp of the obsidian's canvas experience.
problem: Obsidian's canvas has no drawing, annotation, or fast card-creation tools, and no official plugin API to add them.

relations.evidence: Handwriting to text — MyScript application + HMAC keys and the recognition language.

summary: Canvas toolkit that adds drawing and annotation tools, quick note cards, drag-to-make sections, and interactive tables to Obsidian Canvas.
